svg.metadata:
{"format":"org.dxos.dx-svg@1","version":1,"root":"0000000000000FS22V02ZZSFZA","source":{"language":"dsl","text":"diagram kind=sequence
node Dialog "Share dialog" role=actor
node ShareOp "ShareObject op"
node SSM "EDGE SpaceStateMachine"
node Handler "Share link handler"
node Route "EDGE shared-objects route"
node Indexer "EDGE Indexer"
node Plank "Plank"
node Client "Space join"
node Guard "Scope guard"
edge Dialog calls ShareOp "copy link"
edge ShareOp sends SSM "invitation, then DelegatedInvitationScope"
note Handler:right "The guest opens the link"
fragment par "first look" {
  edge Handler calls Route "readSharedObjects, signed with the guest key"
  edge Route calls SSM "grant"
  edge Route calls Indexer "readObjects"
  edge Route returns Handler "SharedObject[]"
  edge Handler sends Plank "first look"
} else "join" {
  edge Handler calls Client "join with syncScope"
  edge Client calls SSM "redeem the invitation"
  edge Client sends Guard "syncScope"
}
edge Client sends Plank "live object replaces the first look"
"},"objects":[
